title: THE CARD IN THE DRAWER · The one lit tube
venue: the motel · a card left in room twelve's nightstand each month by a guest never seen · Box 12
logline: The second card, November: a figure pouring water under a star. He redraws it as the Lanes' sign at night with every tube dark but one, and the alley's puddle under it taking the one tube's light. The star is the tube. The water is the puddle.

panels.composition: A single tall card filling the page, its border drawn as the wooden edge of a motel nightstand drawer; inside the border: a neon sign on a roofline at night with every letter dark but one, which glows, and beneath it a puddle in gravel holding the one letter's light. No numeral, no title; the card's name is the thing.
